name: hud-health-bars
description: Health bars read at a glance: coloured by thirds (green at or above 2/3, amber down to 1/3, red below) on a dark backing, shown for every unit while the show_health_bars key (Alt) is held or the Options toggle is on. Six enemy tanks charge six tanks in Big Arena; the key is held at 6 s and released at 7.5 s, the option is turned on at 8 s. Look at bars-held and bars-option: three colours and the dark edge on sand. Tank against tank, so neither side has an armour edge and the fight is still on at 9 s; eight raiders against the tanks were all wrecks by 6 s once tanks hit light armour twice as hard (#111).

checks.name: key held: every unit shows its bar
checks.code: state.health_bars.forced and state.health_bars.units > 0 and state.health_bars.visible == state.health_bars.units

checks.name: key released, option off: only selected, hovered or hit units show a bar
option on: every unit shows its bar
checks.code: state.health_bars.forced and state.health_bars.units > 0 and state.health_bars.visible == state.health_bars.units
